policy: Catalog ranges are context only; audited excerpts require a case-specific boundary and review note.

cases.tepl_scope: One written operand order of the catalog equation, under the algebraic arithmetic model; source numerical policy is not executed.
cases.xla_conditions: Valid permutations.

cases.tepl_scope: Only binary addition, equal base shapes, identical broadcast maps and added extents; excludes other elementwise functions and scalar expansion.
cases.xla_conditions: Compatible base shapes and broadcast maps; scalar-broadcast operands may be expanded to the common base shape; f elementwise, excluding copy/fusion.

cases.tepl_scope: Only binary multiplication, equal base shapes, identical maps and added extents.
cases.xla_conditions: Compatible base shapes and broadcast maps; scalar-broadcast operands may be expanded to the common base shape; f elementwise, excluding copy/fusion.

cases.tepl_scope: Only the reverse member of the parameterized indexing schema; input broadcast map is empty.
cases.xla_conditions: g is reshape, transpose, reverse, single-output sort, static slice, or data-operand dynamic slice; broadcast source is scalar.

cases.tepl_scope: Only a rank-two transpose with permutation [1,0] and scalar broadcast.
cases.xla_conditions: g is reshape, transpose, reverse, single-output sort, static slice, or data-operand dynamic slice; broadcast source is scalar.

cases.tepl_scope: Only sum with implicit zero initializer, matching the catalog arithmetic case.
cases.xla_conditions: Floating result; additive reducer; scalar zero init.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-three sum, inner axis 1 then outer axis 1; symbolic extents. Does not cover arbitrary combiners/initializers.
cases.xla_conditions: Same initial value by Identical; equivalent reduction computations; single-output path.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-two transpose [1,0], sum over output axis 0, implicit zero initializer.
cases.xla_conditions: Single-output reduction.
cases.xla_policy: Layout-insensitive mode; allow if unconditional flag, result rank<2, one transpose user, or all transpose users are reductions.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-two disjoint lists [0] and [1]; probes a case beyond identical-list cancellation.
cases.xla_conditions: Valid reverse axis sets; empty resulting set returns X.

cases.tepl_scope: Only addition and a scalar broadcast; tests the compound rule directly, not a two-rule sequence.
cases.xla_conditions: f is elementwise binary, excluding compare and rng; other operand is broadcast scalar constant; either operand order.

cases.tepl_scope: Ordinary rank-two matrix products without batch axes; every attribute is reused explicitly.
cases.xla_conditions: Reject if outer contraction consumes an inner batch axis; shared batches and contractions must map through the inner output; valid inferred shapes.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. use_associative_reordering; FLOP improvement threshold; preserve precision configuration.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-two matrix product, output transpose [1,0]; explicit swapped contraction attributes.
cases.xla_conditions: p swaps the complete left/right free-axis blocks while preserving each block order, optionally permuting leading batch axes; canonical path has one free axis per side.
cases.xla_policy: Noncanonical/general form requires supports_non_canonical_dots; parameter-placement policy may suppress swap.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-one inner product; reversal of its sole contracting axis; no free/batch axes.
cases.xla_conditions: Moved reversed axes are contracting; unmatched noncontracting reversals stay on X; either side may be the producer.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. use_associative_reordering; source size-ratio threshold.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-three sum with inner axis 0 then outer axis 0; implicit zero initializer. Compared with the nonleading-axis case.
cases.xla_conditions: Same initial value by Identical; equivalent reduction computations; single-output path.

cases.tepl_scope: Arbitrary input rank, broadcasts only append new dimensions; concatenates new extents explicitly.
cases.xla_conditions: Compatible nested broadcast shapes.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-two matrix product. Proves the identity for any captured X/Y; does not implement parameter-like policy screening.
cases.xla_conditions: X parameter-like; Y not parameter-like.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. enable_move_dot_param_to_rhs.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-one operands, no batches or contractions; same-type ideal arithmetic, no conversions.
cases.xla_conditions: No contraction axes; precision algorithm ALG_UNSET or ALG_DOT_F32_F32_F32; convert operand types to result type when needed.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. enable_dot_to_multiply_rewrite.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-one inner product to multiply then sum; same-type ideal arithmetic, no widened accumulation.
cases.xla_conditions: At least one operand has only batch and contracting axes; precision algorithm ALG_UNSET or ALG_DOT_F32_F32_F32; operands converted to result type before multiply.
cases.xla_policy: Layout-insensitive; enable_dot_strength_reduction; CPU additionally requires both operands to have only batch/contracting axes; skip unreduced sharding marker.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-one batched product reduced over its sole batch axis; no remaining output axes.
cases.xla_conditions: Reducer addition with zero init; at least one reduced output axis is a dot batch axis.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. supports_non_canonical_dots.

cases.tepl_scope: General symmetric difference computed with existing list builtins; no auto.
cases.xla_conditions: Valid reverse axis sets; empty resulting set returns X.

cases.tepl_scope: Scalar Y broadcast to an arbitrary output shape.
cases.xla_conditions: Non-integral; noncomplex unless enable_fast_math.
cases.xla_policy: CPU; enable_sink_broadcast; Y has one user.

cases.tepl_scope: Scalar factor C is a captured scalar; literal-only profitability does not affect the identity.
cases.xla_conditions: Source requires integral arithmetic or enable_fast_math for floating/complex reassociation. C is scalar constant; Y nonconstant.

cases.tepl_scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.
cases.xla_conditions: Input/output ranks and element counts equal; non-sorted d reaches this branch.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-one X; reshape inserts a leading unit axis; the outer broadcast appends axes.
cases.xla_conditions: Reshape only inserts unit dimensions.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-two operand with leading unit axis; broadcast appends axes.
cases.xla_conditions: X has unit dimensions.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. enable_broadcast_degenerate_dimension.

cases.tepl_scope: General insertion-only broadcast/permutation equation; source sorted-map/layout policy remains in the catalog.
cases.xla_conditions: New broadcast map sorted; d sorted; source additionally checks relative mapped-axis layouts in layout-sensitive mode.

cases.tepl_scope: Insert one leading unit axis into rank-one input.
cases.xla_conditions: Reshape only inserts unit dimensions.

cases.tepl_scope: Rank-two matrix transposes, no batches.
cases.xla_conditions: Equal operand permutations; equal ranks; canonical leading batch axes; one free and one contracting axis per side; p only permutes batch axes and optionally swaps final matrix axes.

cases.tepl_scope: One broadcast-created contraction axis; replacement dot is an outer product.
cases.xla_conditions: Moved broadcast-created axes are contracting; remaining broadcast axes stay on the producer side.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. use_associative_reordering; FLOP threshold.

cases.tepl_scope: Reduce the left free axis of a rank-two dot; implicit sum initializer zero.
cases.xla_conditions: Dot has no batch axes; reducer is addition with zero initial value.
cases.xla_policy: Source applies in layout-insensitive mode. raise_slice_and_reduce_through_dot; FLOP threshold.

cases.tepl_scope: Scalar factor pulled from a rank-two f32 dot; source constant/profitability screening is outside the algebraic identity.
cases.xla_conditions: Constant scalar factors along multiply-commuting operations; BF16 or F32; shared-user paths screened before mutation.

cases.tepl_scope: Sum specialization; rank-one base and one broadcast-created axis.
cases.xla_conditions: Every reduced output axis belongs to d (no replication axis is reduced).
